You are composing music in an isolated workspace. Use the bash tool to run commands and complete the task.
Each command runs in /workspace in a fresh bash shell; files and the FT2 session persist between commands. Budget: no limit on steps, 120 minutes; a step is one reply, and every tool call in it runs in order. Every tool result ends with <time_left>, the minutes remaining.
A command still running after 120 seconds is stopped and returns exit code 124 (137 if it had to be killed). Command output over 20,000 bytes shows only its first and last 10,000 bytes.
The `ft2 list` command describes the tracker tools. `ft2 call TOOL 'JSON_OBJECT'` calls one tool. `ft2 batch FILE.json` executes a list of {"name": TOOL, "arguments": {...}} calls in order.
This FT2 build exposes samples, instruments by name, patterns, order, tempo, save and render. Envelopes and note-to-sample mapping are unavailable; shape sounds in the sample data itself.
Python 3 and NumPy are available for creating original sound material, editing files, and analyzing renders. Writing the XM bytes yourself is allowed. Keep it a real tracker module, with instruments and patterns doing the work, not one long pre-rendered sample.
The workspace is offline: no network, no coding-agent client, no skill library. You cannot hear audio; render to WAV with module_render and inspect the result with NumPy to check your work, then revise.
A keygen tune plays in a loop. Compose so the module loops cleanly from its end back to its restart position.
Save the final editable module as /workspace/submission/tune.xm. A WAV preview and source scripts may accompany it. The submission directory may hold at most 128 MiB in at most 4096 regular files (subdirectories are fine; links and special files are not). If the accompanying files break these limits they are dropped and only tune.xm is kept. A trusted process renders the final XM separately.
If the time budget runs out, the session stops and the tune.xm saved at that moment is collected as the submission.
Submit by running exactly this command:
echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
Submission ends the session. There is no second attempt or post-submission repair.

You have FastTracker II and Python/NumPy at your disposal. Make an original keygen tune. Music only.
Choose the sound, tempo, harmony, rhythm, instruments, length and arrangement yourself.
I'll start by exploring the FT2 tooling available.

{"command": "cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import wave,numpy as np
w=wave.open('/tmp/t1.wav'); 
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,2)[:,0].astype(float)
# segment well after note start
seg=d[20000:26000]
def freq(seg,rate=44100):
    seg=seg-seg.mean()
    ac=np.correlate(seg,seg,'full')[len(seg)-1:]
    # find first strong peak after 0
    # exclude very short lags
    lo=20; hi=2000
    p=ac[lo:hi]
    k=np.argmax(p)+lo
    # parabolic interp
    y0,y1,y2=ac[k-1],ac[k],ac[k+1]
    dk=0.5*(y0-y2)/(y0-2*y1+y2) if (y0-2*y1+y2)!=0 else 0
    return rate/(k+dk), k
print(freq(seg))
print(freq(d[100000:106000]))
print('amp', np.abs(d).max())
""}

import numpy as np, base64, json
n=256
t=np.arange(n)/n
x=np.sin(2*np.pi*t)
pcm=(x*25000).astype('<i2').tobytes()
open('/tmp/sine.b64','w').write(base64.b64encode(pcm).decode())
calls=[{'name':'module_new','arguments':{'name':'calib2','channels':4}},
 {'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'pcm':base64.b64encode(pcm).decode(),'encoding':'int16','name':'sine256'}},
 {'name':'sample_set','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'loop_start':0,'loop_length':256,'flags':1}},
 {'name':'song_set','arguments':{'bpm':125,'speed':6}},
 {'name':'pattern_set_length','arguments':{'pattern':0,'rows':64}},
]
notes=['C-3','C-4','C-5','E-4','B-4']
for i,nm in enumerate(notes):
    calls.append({'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':{'pattern':0,'row':i*12,'channel':0,'note':nm,'instrument':1,'volume':64}})
open('/tmp/b1.json','w').write(json.dumps(calls))
" && ft2 batch /tmp/b1.json 2>&1 | tail -3 && ft2 call module_render '{"path":"/tmp/t3.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":8,"loops":1}' && python3 -c "
import wave,numpy as np
w=wave.open('/tmp/t3.wav')
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,2)[:,0].astype(float)
sr=44100
# note starts at rows 0,12,24,36,48 -> 0.12s per row
row=5292
for i in range(5):
    s=i*12*row+2000
    seg=d[s:s+16000]
    W=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))
    f=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    k=np.argmax(W)
    # refine
    print(i, round(f[k],2))

import numpy as np, base64, json
n=256

open('/tmp/sine.b64','w').write(base64.b64encode(pcm).decode())
calls=[{'name':'module_new','arguments':{'name':'calib2','channels':4}},
 {'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'pcm':base64.b64encode(pcm).decode(),'encoding':'int16','name':'sine256'}},
 {'name':'sample_set','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'loop_start':0,'loop_length':256,'flags':1}},
 {'name':'song_set','arguments':{'bpm':125,'speed':6}},
 {'name':'pattern_set_length','arguments':{'pattern':0,'rows':64}},
]
notes=['C-3','C-4','C-5','E-4','B-4']
for i,nm in enumerate(notes):
    calls.append({'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':{'pattern':0,'row':i*12,'channel':0,'note':nm,'instrument':1,'volume':64}})
open('/tmp/b1.json','w').write(json.dumps(calls))
" && ft2 batch /tmp/b1.json 2>&1 | tail -3 && ft2 call module_render '{"path":"/tmp/t3.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":8,"loops":1}' && python3 -c "
import wave,numpy as np
w=wave.open('/tmp/t3.wav')
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,2)[:,0].astype(float)
sr=44100
# note starts at rows 0,12,24,36,48 -> 0.12s per row
row=5292
for i in range(5):
    s=i*12*row+2000
    seg=d[s:s+16000]
    W=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))
    f=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    k=np.argmax(W)
    # refine
    print(i, round(f[k],2))
"

"""Shell client for one persistent FT2 stdio MCP process, inside the sandbox."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import socket
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SOCKET = "/tmp/keygen-ft2.sock"
LIMIT = 240 * 1024


def exchange(message: dict) -> dict:
    raw = json.dumps(message).encode() + b"\n"
    if len(raw) > LIMIT:
        raise ValueError("FT2 request too large; use sample_load for large PCM")
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as sock:
        sock.settimeout(600)
        sock.connect(SOCKET)
        sock.sendall(raw)
        with sock.makefile("rb") as reader:
            result = reader.readline(LIMIT + 1)
    if len(result) > LIMIT:
        raise ValueError("FT2 response too large")
    reply = json.loads(result)
    if "error" in reply:
        raise RuntimeError(reply["error"])
    return reply["result"]


def serve(binary: str) -> None:
    # The Docker image includes only the existing transport, not repository prompts.
    sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/keygen")
    from tools.ft2_transport import StdioMCP

    client = StdioMCP([binary, "--mcp"], Path("/workspace"), timeout=600)
    try:
        client.initialize()
        tools = client.request("tools/list", {})
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as server:
            server.bind(SOCKET)
            server.listen(8)
            while True:
                with server.accept()[0] as connection:
                    connection.settimeout(30)
                    try:
                        with connection.makefile("rb") as reader:
                            raw = reader.readline(LIMIT + 1)
                        if len(raw) > LIMIT:
                            raise ValueError("request too large")
                        message = json.loads(raw)
                        if message.get("op") == "list":
                            result = tools
                        elif message.get("op") == "call":
                            result = client.request("tools/call", {
                                "name": message["name"], "arguments": message.get("arguments", {})})
                        else:
                            raise ValueError("unknown bridge operation")
                        reply = {"result": result}
                    except Exception as exc:
                        reply = {"error": str(exc)}
                    try:
                        connection.sendall(json.dumps(reply).encode() + b"\n")
                    except (BrokenPipeError, OSError):
                        pass
    finally:

import argparse
import json
import socket
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SOCKET = "/tmp/keygen-ft2.sock"
LIMIT = 240 * 1024


def exchange(message: dict) -> dict:
    raw = json.dumps(message).encode() + b"\n"
    if len(raw) > LIMIT:
        raise ValueError("FT2 request too large; use sample_load for large PCM")
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as sock:
        sock.settimeout(600)
        sock.connect(SOCKET)
        sock.sendall(raw)
        with sock.makefile("rb") as reader:
            result = reader.readline(LIMIT + 1)
    if len(result) > LIMIT:
        raise ValueError("FT2 response too large")
    reply = json.loads(result)
    if "error" in reply:
        raise RuntimeError(reply["error"])
    return reply["result"]

import json,base64,numpy as np,subprocess,wave,sys

def pcm_b64(x, enc='int16'):
    if x.dtype==np.float32 or x.dtype==np.float64:
        arr=(np.clip(x,-1,1)*32767).astype('<i2')
    else:
        arr=x.astype('<i2')
    return base64.b64encode(arr.tobytes()).decode()

def run(calls):
    open('/tmp/_x.json','w').write(json.dumps(calls))
    out=subprocess.run(['ft2','batch','/tmp/_x.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='/workspace')
    if out.returncode!=0:
        print('BATCH ERR', out.stdout[-2000:], out.stderr[-2000:])
    return out

def render(path='/tmp/o.wav', loops=1, amp=8):
    out=subprocess.run(['ft2','call','module_render',json.dumps({'path':path,'rate':44100,'bits':16,'amp':amp,'loops':loops})],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd='/workspace')
    if 'isError' in out.stdout:

    try:

        return d, w.getframerate()
    except Exception as e:
        print('render err',e, out.stdout); return None

```python
T=32
def P(n): return 8363.0*2**((n-49)/12)
PERC_NOTE=78  # used for one-shots

def bcycle(proto_fn, T=32, H=15, tilt=None):
    N=8192
    t=np.arange(N)/N
    p=proto_fn(t)
    X=np.fft.rfft(p)/N
    i=np.arange(T)
    y=np.zeros(T)
    for h in range(1,H+1):
        c=2*X[h]
        a=np.abs(c); ph=np.angle(c)
        if tilt: a*=tilt(h)
        y+=a*np.cos(2*np.pi*h*i/T+ph)
    y/= np.max(np.abs(y))+1e-12
    return y*0.92
```

```python
import numpy as np, json, subprocess, base64, wave, math, sys

T=32
def P(n): return 8363.0*2**((n-49)/12)
PERC_NOTE=78  # used for one-shots
PRATE=P(PERC_NOTE)  # effective sample rate for generated percussion

def bcycle(proto_fn, T=32, H=15, tilt=None):
    N=8192
    t=np.arange(N)/N
    p=proto_fn(t)
    X=np.fft.rfft(p)/N
    i=np.arange(T)
    y=np.zeros(T)
    for h in range(1,H+1):
        c=2*X[h]
        a=np.abs(c); ph=np.angle(c)
        if tilt: a*=tilt(h)
        y+=a*np.cos(2*np.pi*h*i/T+ph)
    y/= np.max(np.abs(y))+1e-12
    return y*0.92
```

```python
import numpy as np, json, subprocess, base64, wave, math, sys

T=32
def P(n): return 8363.0*2**((n-49)/12)
PERC_NOTE=78  # used for one-shots

def bcycle(proto_fn, T=32, H=15, tilt=None):
    N=8192
    t=np.arange(N)/N
    p=proto_fn(t)
    X=np.fft.rfft(p)/N
    i=np.arange(T)
    y=np.zeros(T)
    for h in range(1,H+1):
        c=2*X[h]
        a=np.abs(c); ph=np.angle(c)
        if tilt: a*=tilt(h)
        y+=a*np.cos(2*np.pi*h*i/T+ph)
    y/= np.max(np.abs(y))+1e-12
    return y*0.92
```

```python
import numpy as np, json, subprocess, base64, wave, math, sys

T=32
def P(n): return 8363.0*2**((n-49)/12)
PERC_NOTE=78  # used for one-shots
PRATE=P(PERC_NOTE)  # effective sample rate for generated percussion

def bcycle(proto_fn, T=32, H=15, tilt=None):
    N=8192
    t=np.arange(N)/N
    p=proto_fn(t)
    X=np.fft.rfft(p)/N
    i=np.arange(T)
    y=np.zeros(T)
    for h in range(1,H+1):
        c=2*X[h]
        a=np.abs(c); ph=np.angle(c)
        if tilt: a*=tilt(h)
        y+=a*np.cos(2*np.pi*h*i/T+ph)
    y/= np.max(np.abs(y))+1e-12
    return y*0.92
```

```python
import numpy as np, json, subprocess, base64, wave, math, sys

T=32
def P(n): return 8363.0*2**((n-49)/12)
PERC_NOTE=78  # used for one-shots
PRATE=P(PERC_NOTE)  # effective sample rate for generated percussion

def bcycle(proto_fn, T=32, H=15, tilt=None):
    N=8192
    t=np.arange(N)/N
    p=proto_fn(t)
    X=np.fft.rfft(p)/N
    i=np.arange(T)
    y=np.zeros(T)
    for h in range(1,H+1):
        c=2*X[h]
        a=np.abs(c); ph=np.angle(c)
        if tilt: a*=tilt(h)
        y+=a*np.cos(2*np.pi*h*i/T+ph)
    y/= np.max(np.abs(y))+1e-12
    return y*0.92
```

"""Generate all instrument samples as WAV files."""
import numpy as np, wave, os, sys
from waves import *

OUT = '/workspace/src/wav'
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

PERC_NOTE = 78
PR = rate(PERC_NOTE)          # effective sample rate for one-shot percussion

def save(name, x, srate):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    x = np.clip(x, -1.0, 1.0)
    p = (x*32000).astype('<i2')
    w = wave.open(f'{OUT}/{name}.wav','wb')
    w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(int(srate))
    w.writeframes(p.tobytes()); w.close()
    return len(p)

def white(n, seed=None):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    return rng.normal(0, 1.0, n)

def spec_filter(x, sr, gain):
    """apply magnitude curve in frequency domain (linear phase)"""
    N = len(x)
    X = np.fft.rfft(x)
    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(N, 1.0/sr)
    X *= gain(f)
    return np.fft.irfft(X, N)

def env_exp(n, sr, tau):
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    return np.exp(-t/tau)

# ---------------- percussion ----------------
def make_kick(sr=PR):
    n = int(0.42*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    f = 45 + 165*np.exp(-t/0.026)
    ph = 2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/sr
    body = np.sin(ph)*np.exp(-t/0.115)
    sub  = np.sin(2*np.pi*44*t)*np.exp(-t/0.22)*0.45
    click = np.sin(2*np.pi*1150*t)*np.exp(-t/0.0055)*0.55
    nz = white(n, 1)*np.exp(-t/0.0035)*0.35
    y = body + sub + click + nz
    y = np.tanh(1.7*y)*0.95
    y *= np.exp(-t*1.2)                       # gentle tail trim
    fade = np.minimum(1.0, t/0.0005)
    y *= fade
    return y

def make_snare(sr=PR):
    n = int(0.32*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    nz = white(n, 2)
    # bright noise body: keep 900Hz..8k with a bump around 2.2k
    def g(f):
        hp = 1.0/(1.0+(900.0/np.maximum(f,1e-3))**3)          # highpass
        lp = 1.0/(1.0+(np.maximum(f,1e-3)/9000.0)**4)         # lowpass
        pk = 1.0 + 0.9*np.exp(-((f-2200.0)/1400.0)**2)
        return hp*lp*pk
    nd = spec_filter(nz, sr, g)
    nd = nd/np.max(np.abs(nd))
    crack = nd*np.exp(-t/0.030)
    tail  = nd*np.exp(-t/0.11)*0.45
    body = (np.sin(2*np.pi*192*t) + 0.7*np.sin(2*np.pi*287*t))*np.exp(-t/0.075)*0.5
    y = crack + tail + body
    y = np.tanh(1.2*y)
    y /= np.max(np.abs(y))
    return y*0.92

def metallic_partials(ratios, base, n, sr, decay, seeds=None):
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for i, r in enumerate(ratios):
        y += np.sin(2*np.pi*base*r*t + i)*np.exp(-t/(decay*(0.6+0.5/(1+i*0.5))))
    return y

def make_hat(open_=False, sr=PR):
    dur = 0.30 if open_ else 0.085
    n = int(dur*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    ratios = [1.0, 1.41, 1.68, 2.13, 2.51, 3.17, 3.86, 4.63]
    base = 3650.0
    part = metallic_partials(ratios, base, n, sr, 0.030 if not open_ else 0.115)
    part /= (np.max(np.abs(part))+1e-12)
    nz = white(n, 4)
    def g(f):
        return 1.0/(1.0+(5200.0/np.maximum(f,1e-3))**4) * 1.0
    nd = spec_filter(nz, sr, g)
    nd /= np.max(np.abs(nd))+1e-12
    nzpart = nd*np.exp(-t/(0.012 if not open_ else 0.10))
    y = 0.55*part + 0.75*nzpart
    y *= np.exp(-t/(0.075 if open_ else 0.030))
    y = y/np.max(np.abs(y))*0.85
    return y

def make_crash(sr=PR):
    n = int(1.5*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    nz = white(n, 7)
    def g(f):
        hp = 1.0/(1.0+(3800.0/np.maximum(f,1e-3))**4)
        lp = 1.0/(1.0+(np.maximum(f,1e-3)/13500.0)**6)
        return hp*lp
    nd = spec_filter(nz, sr, g)
    nd /= np.max(np.abs(nd))+1e-12
    ratios = [1.0,1.37,1.79,2.21,2.83,3.49]
    part = metallic_partials(ratios, 5200.0, n, sr, 0.35)
    part /= np.max(np.abs(part))+1e-12
    y = nd*np.exp(-t/0.55) + 0.35*part*np.exp(-t/0.30)
    y *= (1.0-np.exp(-t/0.002))
    y /= np.max(np.abs(y))
    return y*0.8

def make_tom(sr=PR):
    n = int(0.30*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    f = 190 + 120*np.exp(-t/0.06)
    ph = 2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/sr
    body = np.sin(ph)*np.exp(-t/0.13)
    nz = white(n, 11)*np.exp(-t/0.012)*0.25
    y = body + nz
    y = np.tanh(1.3*y)/np.tanh(1.3)
    return y*0.85

# ---------------- tonal (looped wavetables, tt=32 stored samples per period) ----------------
def harm(a):
    """build a single cycle from harmonic amplitudes a[0..] (h=1..), all in phase"""
    tt = T
    i = np.arange(tt)
    y = np.zeros(tt)
    for h, amp in enumerate(a, start=1):
        y += amp*np.cos(2*np.pi*h*i/tt)
    return 0.94*y/(np.max(np.abs(y))+1e-12)

def pulse_proto(duty):
    return lambda t: np.where((t % 1.0) < duty, 1.0, -1.0)

def mk(kind):
    if kind == 'bass':
        a = [1.0,0.74,0.56,0.46,0.37,0.29,0.22,0.17,0.13,0.095,0.07,0.05,0.035,0.024,0.016]
        return loop_of(harm(a), 4)
    if kind == 'lead':
        p = bcycle(lambda t: 0.45*saw(t) + 0.55*pulse_proto(0.24)(t),
                   H=15, tilt=lambda h: np.exp(-(max(0, h-9)/7.0)**2))
        return loop_of(p, 4)
    if kind == 'lead2':          # brighter variant used for echo / accents
        p = bcycle(lambda t: 0.30*saw(t) + 0.70*pulse_proto(0.16)(t),
                   H=15, tilt=lambda h: np.exp(-(max(0, h-11)/8.0)**2))
        return loop_of(p, 2)
    if kind == 'pad':
        a = [1.0,0.55,0.44,0.30,0.26,0.17,0.13,0.085,0.06,0.04,0.026,0.016]
        return loop_of(harm(a), 8)
    if kind == 'chip':
        return loop_of(bcycle(pulse_proto(0.14), H=15, tilt=lambda h: np.exp(-(h/13.0)**3)), 2)
    if kind == 'organ':         # soft 25% pulse chord filler
        return loop_of(bcycle(lambda t: 0.6*pulse_proto(0.30)(t)+0.4*tri(t),
                   H=15, tilt=lambda h: np.exp(-(h/7.0)**2)), 4)
    raise KeyError(kind)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    info = {}
    for name, x, sr in [
        ('kick',   make_kick(), PR),
        ('snare',  make_snare(), PR),
        ('hat',    make_hat(False), PR),
        ('openhat',make_hat(True), PR),
        ('crash',  make_crash(), PR),
        ('tom',    make_tom(), PR),
    ]:
        info[name] = save(name, x, sr)
    for kind in ['bass','lead','lead2','pad','chip','organ']:
        y = mk(kind)
        # verify seamless loop
        seam = max(abs(y[0]-y[-1]), abs(y[1]-y[0]))
        info[kind] = save(kind, y, 32000)
        print(f'{kind:8s} len={len(y):5d}  loopstep={abs(y[0]-y[-1]):.3f} max={abs(y).max():.2f}')
    print(info)

"""Generate all instrument samples as WAV files."""
import numpy as np, wave, os, sys
from waves import *

OUT = '/workspace/src/wav'
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

PERC_NOTE = 78
PR = rate(PERC_NOTE)          # effective sample rate for one-shot percussion

def save(name, x, srate):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    x = np.clip(x, -1.0, 1.0)
    p = (x*32000).astype('<i2')
    w = wave.open(f'{OUT}/{name}.wav','wb')
    w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(int(srate))
    w.writeframes(p.tobytes()); w.close()
    return len(p)

def white(n, seed=None):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    return rng.normal(0, 1.0, n)

def spec_filter(x, sr, gain):
    """apply magnitude curve in frequency domain (linear phase)"""
    N = len(x)
    X = np.fft.rfft(x)
    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(N, 1.0/sr)
    X *= gain(f)
    return np.fft.irfft(X, N)

def env_exp(n, sr, tau):
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    return np.exp(-t/tau)

# ---------------- percussion ----------------
def make_kick(sr=PR):
    n = int(0.42*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    f = 45 + 165*np.exp(-t/0.026)
    ph = 2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/sr
    body = np.sin(ph)*np.exp(-t/0.115)
    sub  = np.sin(2*np.pi*44*t)*np.exp(-t/0.22)*0.45
    click = np.sin(2*np.pi*1150*t)*np.exp(-t/0.0055)*0.55
    nz = white(n, 1)*np.exp(-t/0.0035)*0.35
    y = body + sub + click + nz
    y = np.tanh(1.7*y)*0.95
    y *= np.exp(-t*1.2)                       # gentle tail trim
    fade = np.minimum(1.0, t/0.0005)
    y *= fade
    return y

def make_snare(sr=PR):
    n = int(0.32*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    nz = white(n, 2)
    # bright noise body: keep 900Hz..8k with a bump around 2.2k
    def g(f):
        hp = 1.0/(1.0+(900.0/np.maximum(f,1e-3))**3)          # highpass
        lp = 1.0/(1.0+(np.maximum(f,1e-3)/9000.0)**4)         # lowpass
        pk = 1.0 + 0.9*np.exp(-((f-2200.0)/1400.0)**2)
        return hp*lp*pk
    nd = spec_filter(nz, sr, g)
    nd = nd/np.max(np.abs(nd))
    crack = nd*np.exp(-t/0.030)
    tail  = nd*np.exp(-t/0.11)*0.45
    body = (np.sin(2*np.pi*192*t) + 0.7*np.sin(2*np.pi*287*t))*np.exp(-t/0.075)*0.5
    y = crack + tail + body
    y = np.tanh(1.2*y)
    y /= np.max(np.abs(y))
    return y*0.92

def metallic_partials(ratios, base, n, sr, decay, seeds=None):
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for i, r in enumerate(ratios):
        y += np.sin(2*np.pi*base*r*t + i)*np.exp(-t/(decay*(0.6+0.5/(1+i*0.5))))
    return y

def make_hat(open_=False, sr=PR):
    dur = 0.30 if open_ else 0.085
    n = int(dur*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    ratios = [1.0, 1.41, 1.68, 2.13, 2.51, 3.17, 3.86, 4.63]
    base = 3650.0
    part = metallic_partials(ratios, base, n, sr, 0.030 if not open_ else 0.115)
    part /= (np.max(np.abs(part))+1e-12)
    nz = white(n, 4)
    def g(f):
        return 1.0/(1.0+(5200.0/np.maximum(f,1e-3))**4) * 1.0
    nd = spec_filter(nz, sr, g)
    nd /= np.max(np.abs(nd))+1e-12
    nzpart = nd*np.exp(-t/(0.012 if not open_ else 0.10))
    y = 0.55*part + 0.75*nzpart
    y *= np.exp(-t/(0.075 if open_ else 0.030))
    y = y/np.max(np.abs(y))*0.85
    return y

def make_crash(sr=PR):
    n = int(1.5*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    nz = white(n, 7)
    def g(f):
        hp = 1.0/(1.0+(3800.0/np.maximum(f,1e-3))**4)
        lp = 1.0/(1.0+(np.maximum(f,1e-3)/13500.0)**6)
        return hp*lp
    nd = spec_filter(nz, sr, g)
    nd /= np.max(np.abs(nd))+1e-12
    ratios = [1.0,1.37,1.79,2.21,2.83,3.49]
    part = metallic_partials(ratios, 5200.0, n, sr, 0.35)
    part /= np.max(np.abs(part))+1e-12
    y = nd*np.exp(-t/0.55) + 0.35*part*np.exp(-t/0.30)
    y *= (1.0-np.exp(-t/0.002))
    y /= np.max(np.abs(y))
    return y*0.8

def make_tom(sr=PR):
    n = int(0.30*sr)
    t = np.arange(n)/sr
    f = 190 + 120*np.exp(-t/0.06)
    ph = 2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/sr
    body = np.sin(ph)*np.exp(-t/0.13)
    nz = white(n, 11)*np.exp(-t/0.012)*0.25
    y = body + nz
    y = np.tanh(1.3*y)/np.tanh(1.3)
    return y*0.85

# ---------------- tonal (looped wavetables, tt=32 stored samples per period) ----------------
def harm(a):
    """build a single cycle from harmonic amplitudes a[0..] (h=1..), all in phase"""
    tt = T
    i = np.arange(tt)
    y = np.zeros(tt)
    for h, amp in enumerate(a, start=1):
        y += amp*np.cos(2*np.pi*h*i/tt)
    return 0.94*y/(np.max(np.abs(y))+1e-12)

def pulse_proto(duty):
    return lambda t: np.where((t % 1.0) < duty, 1.0, -1.0)

def mk(kind):
    if kind == 'bass':
        a = [1.0,0.74,0.56,0.46,0.37,0.29,0.22,0.17,0.13,0.095,0.07,0.05,0.035,0.024,0.016]
        return loop_of(harm(a), 4)
    if kind == 'lead':
        p = bcycle(lambda t: 0.45*saw(t) + 0.55*pulse_proto(0.24)(t),
                   H=15, tilt=lambda h: np.exp(-(max(0, h-9)/7.0)**2))
        return loop_of(p, 4)
    if kind == 'lead2':          # brighter variant used for echo / accents
        p = bcycle(lambda t: 0.30*saw(t) + 0.70*pulse_proto(0.16)(t),
                   H=15, tilt=lambda h: np.exp(-(max(0, h-11)/8.0)**2))
        return loop_of(p, 2)
    if kind == 'pad':
        a = [1.0,0.55,0.44,0.30,0.26,0.17,0.13,0.085,0.06,0.04,0.026,0.016]
        return loop_of(harm(a), 8)
    if kind == 'chip':
        return loop_of(bcycle(pulse_proto(0.14), H=15, tilt=lambda h: np.exp(-(h/13.0)**3)), 2)
    if kind == 'organ':         # soft 25% pulse chord filler
        return loop_of(bcycle(lambda t: 0.6*pulse_proto(0.30)(t)+0.4*tri(t),
                   H=15, tilt=lambda h: np.exp(-(h/7.0)**2)), 4)
    raise KeyError(kind)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    info = {}
    for name, x, sr in [
        ('kick',   make_kick(), PR),
        ('snare',  make_snare(), PR),
        ('hat',    make_hat(False), PR),
        ('openhat',make_hat(True), PR),
        ('crash',  make_crash(), PR),
        ('tom',    make_tom(), PR),
    ]:
        info[name] = save(name, x, sr)
    for kind in ['bass','lead','lead2','pad','chip','organ']:
        y = mk(kind)
        # verify seamless loop
        seam = max(abs(y[0]-y[-1]), abs(y[1]-y[0]))
        info[kind] = save(kind, y, 32000)
        print(f'{kind:8s} len={len(y):5d}  loopstep={abs(y[0]-y[-1]):.3f} max={abs(y).max():.2f}')
    print(info)

import struct, sys
def load(path):
    d = open(path,'rb').read()
    assert d[:17] == b'Extended Module:', 'not xm'
    name = d[17:37].rstrip(b'\0').decode('latin1')
    p = 60
    hlen, orderlen = struct.unpack_from('<HH', d, p)  # after 'Extended Module:' +20+...
    # header layout: id(17) name(20) 0x1a(1) tracker(20) ver(2) hdrsize(4) songlen(2) restart(2)
    ver, hdrsize = struct.unpack_from('<HI', d, 42)
    songlen, restart = struct.unpack_from('<HH', d, 46)
    chans, npat, ninst = struct.unpack_from('<HHH', d, 48)
    flags, tempo, bpm = struct.unpack_from('<HHH', d, 50)
    order = list(d[54:54+songlen])
    off = 54 + ((orderlen+15)//16)*16
    pats = []
    for i in range(npat):
        plen, ptype = struct.unpack_from('<HB', d, off); off += 5
        rows, packed = struct.unpack_from('<HH', d, off); off += 4
        data = d[off:off+packed]; off += packed
        cells = []
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(chans):
                b = data[r*chans*?  : 0] if False else None
        pats.append((plen, rows, packed, data))
    inst = []
    for i in range(ninst):
        isz, = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, off)
        blk = d[off:off+(isz if isz else 0)]
        off += isz if isz else 0
        nm = blk[4:26].rstrip(b'\0').decode('latin1')
        nsamp, = struct.unpack_from('<H', blk, 27)
        samples = []
        if nsamp:
            sh = blk[33:]
            for k in range(nsamp):
                ln, ls, ll = struct.unpack_from('<III', sh, k*40)
                volflag = sh[k*40+14]; pan = sh[k*40+15]
                typ = sh[k*40+13]
                sname = sh[k*40+18:k*40+40].rstrip(b'\0').decode('latin1')
                samples.append((ln, ls, ll, volflag, pan, typ, sname))
            p = 33 + nsamp*40
            if struct.unpack_from('<H', blk, 29)[0]:  # sample header size
                p = struct.unpack_from('<I', blk, 29) if False else p
        inst.append((nm, nsamp, samples))
    return dict(name=name, ver=ver, chans=chans, npat=npat, ninst=ninst, order=order,
                tempo=tempo, bpm=bpm, pats=pats, inst=inst, songlen=songlen)
if __name__ == '__main__':
    m = load(sys.argv[1])
    print('name', m['name'], 'chans', m['chans'], 'bpm', m['bpm'], 'tempo', m['tempo'], 'pats', m['npat'], 'order', m['order'])
    for i, (nm, ns, sample) in enumerate(m['inst'], 1):
        if ns:
            ln, ls, ll, vol, pan, typ, sn = sample[0]
            print(f'{i:2d} {nm:12s} len={ln:6d} loop={ls},{ll} flags={typ} vol={vol} pan={pan} {sn}')
    for i, (plen, rows, packed, data) in enumerate(m['pats']):
        print('pat', i, 'len', packed, 'rows', rows)

def decode_pattern(data, rows, chans):
    """returns rows x chans list of (note, inst, vol, eff, param)"""
    out = []

            else:

In XM, after the pattern header (pattern header length value at offset 0 of the block), the data offset uses the actual header size field: pattern header size (usually 9) then rows cell data. The proper way: read header size at block start `ph_len` and then advance by ph_len bytes total, not 5+... Let me redo: each pattern block:
- plen (4 bytes) = pattern header size (usually 9)
- packing type (1 byte) = 0

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, json, subprocess, wave, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from exp import *
import numpy as np
# low-level tone in a WAV at declared 8363 Hz
sr=8363
L=int(0.5*sr)
t=np.arange(L)/sr
x=(np.sin(2*np.pi*261.34*32/32*t)*0.5)  # 261.34 Hz
x=(np.sin(2*np.pi*261.34*t)*0.5)
pcm=(x*32000).astype('<i2')
w=wave.open('/tmp/ton.wav','wb'); w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(sr)
w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes()); w.close()
b64=base64.b64encode(pcm.tobytes()).decode()
# module A: via sample_load
run([{'name':'module_new','arguments':{'name':'A','channels':2}},
     {'name':'sample_load','arguments':{'path':'/tmp/ton.wav','instrument':1}},
     {'name':'song_set','arguments':{'bpm':125,'speed':6}},
     {'name':'pattern_set_length','arguments':{'pattern':0,'rows':8}},
     {'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':{'pattern':0,'row':0,'channel':0,'note':'C-4','instrument':1,'volume':64}}])
render('/tmp/a.wav')
run([{'name':'module_save','arguments':{'path':'/tmp/a.xm','format':'xm'}}])
# module B: via create_from_pcm int16
run([{'name':'module_new','arguments':{'name':'B','channels':2}},
     {'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'pcm':b64,'encoding':'int16','name':'ton'}},
     {'name':'song_set','arguments':{'bpm':125,'speed':6}},
     {'name':'pattern_set_length','arguments':{'pattern':0,'rows':8}},
     {'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':{'pattern':0,'row':0,'channel':0,'note':'C-4','instrument':1,'volume':64}}])
render('/tmp/b.wav')
run([{'name':'module_save','arguments':{'path':'/tmp/b.xm','format':'xm'}}])
for f,tag in [('/tmp/a.xm','load'),('/tmp/b.xm','pcm')]:
    d=open(f,'rb').read()
    off=60+276
    hs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off); packed,=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,off+7)
    off+=hs+packed
    ihs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off)
    sh=d[off+ihs:off+ihs+40]
    ln,ls,ll=struct.unpack_from('<III',sh)
    print(tag,'len',ln,'type',sh[14],'ft',sh[13],'rel',sh[16],'filelen',len(d))
for f in ['/tmp/a.wav','/tmp/b.wav']:
    w=wave.open(f); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,2)[:,0].astype(float)
    seg=x[3000:14000]
    W=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))
    tot=W.sum()
    f2=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/44100)
    k=np.argmax(W)
    # noise estimate: total energy - energy near the peak harmonics
    noise = tot - W[max(0,k-30):k+30].sum()
    print(f, 'peak f', round(f2[k],1), 'THD+N approx', round(noise/tot,5))

{"command": "cat > /workspace/src/analyze.py <<'EOF'
import wave, numpy as np, sys

def load(path='/tmp/out.wav'):
    w = wave.open(path)
    d = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype='<i2')
    n = w.getnchannels()
    d = d.reshape(-1, n).astype(float)
    return d, w.getframerate()

NOTE = ['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B']
def nname(f):
    # frequency -> nearest note name assuming A4 = 439.5 (our tuning base)
    n = 49 + 12*np.log2(f/261.34)
    ni = int(round(n))
    cents = 100*(n-ni)
    return f'{NOTE[(ni-1)%12]}{(ni-1)//12} {cents:+.0f}c'

def peaks(d, t0, dur=0.25, sr=44100, nwin=4096, k=6, mono=True):
    x = d[:,0] if mono else d.mean(axis=1)
    x = d.mean(axis=1)
    i0 = int(t0*sr)
    seg = x[i0:i0+nwin]
    seg = seg - seg.mean()
    W = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))
    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg), 1/sr)
    # local maxima
    idx = np.where((W[1:-1] > W[:-2]) & (W[1:-1] > W[2:]) & (W[1:-1] > W.max()*0.02))[0]+1
    idx = idx[np.argsort(W[idx])[::-1][:k]]
    return sorted([(round(f[i],1), W[i]/W[idx].max()) for i in idx])

def timesig(d, sr=44100, blk=int(0.05*44100)):
    n = d.shape[0]//blk
    return np.array([np.sqrt((d[i*blk:(i+1)*blk]**2).mean()) for i in range(n)])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    d, sr = load(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/tmp/out.wav')
    for t0 in [float(x) for x in sys.argv[2].split(',')] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else []:
        ps = peaks(d, t0)
        print(f't={t0:6.2f}s  ', [f'{f:6.1f}Hz {a:.2f} ({nname(f)})' for f, a in ps])
EOF

import wave, numpy as np, sys

def load(path='/tmp/out.wav'):
    w = wave.open(path)
    d = np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()), dtype='<i2')
    n = w.getnchannels()
    d = d.reshape(-1, n).astype(float)
    return d, w.getframerate()

NOTE = ['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B']
def nname(f):
    # frequency -> nearest note name assuming A4 = 439.5 (our tuning base)
    n = 49 + 12*np.log2(f/261.34)
    ni = int(round(n))
    cents = 100*(n-ni)
    return f'{NOTE[(ni-1)%12]}{(ni-1)//12} {cents:+.0f}c'

def peaks(d, t0, dur=0.25, sr=44100, nwin=4096, k=6, mono=True):
    x = d[:,0] if mono else d.mean(axis=1)
    x = d.mean(axis=1)
    i0 = int(t0*sr)
    seg = x[i0:i0+nwin]
    seg = seg - seg.mean()
    W = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))
    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg), 1/sr)
    # local maxima
    idx = np.where((W[1:-1] > W[:-2]) & (W[1:-1] > W[2:]) & (W[1:-1] > W.max()*0.02))[0]+1
    idx = idx[np.argsort(W[idx])[::-1][:k]]
    return sorted([(round(f[i],1), W[i]/W[idx].max()) for i in idx])

def timesig(d, sr=44100, blk=int(0.05*44100)):
    n = d.shape[0]//blk
    return np.array([np.sqrt((d[i*blk:(i+1)*blk]**2).mean()) for i in range(n)])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    d, sr = load(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/tmp/out.wav')
    for t0 in [float(x) for x in sys.argv[2].split(',')] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else []:
        ps = peaks(d, t0)
        print(f't={t0:6.2f}s  ', [f'{f:6.1f}Hz {a:.2f} ({nname(f)})' for f, a in ps])
EOF

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, json, subprocess, wave
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from exp import *
import numpy as np
insts={1:'kick',2:'snare',3:'tom',4:'hat',5:'openhat',6:'crash',7:'bass',8:'pad',9:'organ',10:'chip',11:'lead',12:'lead2'}
def build(idx, note):
    path=f'/workspace/src/wav/{insts[idx]}.wav'
    w=wave.open(path); ln=w.getnframes(); w.close()
    looped = insts[idx] in ('bass','pad','organ','chip','lead','lead2')
    calls=[{'name':'module_new','arguments':{'name':'T','channels':2}},
           {'name':'sample_load','arguments':{'path':path,'instrument':idx}},
           {'name':'sample_set','arguments':({'instrument':idx,'sample':0,'volume':64,'loop_start':0,'loop_length':ln,'flags':1} if looped else {'instrument':idx,'sample':0,'volume':64,'flags':0})},
           {'name':'song_set','arguments':{'bpm':145,'speed':6}},
           {'name':'pattern_set_length','arguments':{'pattern':0,'rows':32}},
           {'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':{'pattern':0,'row':0,'channel':0,'note':note,'instrument':idx,'volume':64}}]
    run(calls)
for idx in [7,8,9,10,11,12]:
    build(idx,'C-5'); (d,sr)=render('/tmp/i.wav')
    seg=d[3000:14000,0]-d[3000:14000,0].mean()
    ac=np.correlate(seg,seg,'full')[len(seg)-1:]
    k=np.argmax(ac[20:2000])+20
    print(f'inst {idx} ({insts[idx]}): freq {44100/k:8.2f} Hz  expected C-5 = 522.69')
for idx in [1,2,4,5,6]:
    build(idx,'C-4'); (d,sr)=render('/tmp/i.wav')
    e=np.abs(d[:,0])
    m=e> e.max()*0.005
    ii=np.where(m)[0]
    print(f'perc {idx} ({insts[idx]}): onset {ii[0] if len(ii) else -1} end {ii[-1]} -> dur {(ii[-1]-ii[0])/44100:.3f}s')
PY

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from exp import *
import numpy as np
t=np.arange(256)/256
pcm=(np.sin(2*np.pi*t)*30000).astype('<i2').tobytes()

run([{'name':'module_new','arguments':{'name':'T','channels':2}},
     {'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'pcm':b64,'encoding':'int16','name':'s'}},
     {'name':'sample_set','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'loop_start':0,'loop_length':256,'flags':1}},
     {'name':'song_set','arguments':{'bpm':145,'speed':6}},
     {'name':'pattern_set_length','arguments':{'pattern':0,'rows':16}},
     {'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':{'pattern':0,'row':0,'channel':0,'note':'C-4','instrument':1,'volume':64}},
     {'name':'module_save','arguments':{'path':'/tmp/rr.xm','format':'xm'}}])
(d,sr)=render('/tmp/r1.wav')
def f0(d):
    seg=d[2000:14000,0]-d[2000:14000,0].mean()
    ac=np.correlate(seg,seg,'full')[len(seg)-1:]
    k=np.argmax(ac[100:8000])+100

print('in-memory freq', round(f0(d),3), '(expect 32.668)')
run([{'name':'module_load','arguments':{'path':'/tmp/rr.xm'}},
     {'name':'sample_save','arguments':{'path':'/tmp/re.wav','instrument':1,'sample':0,'format':'wav'}}])
import wave
w=wave.open('/tmp/re.wav'); y=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i1').astype(float)
print('reloaded export frames',len(y),'width',w.getsampwidth())
(d,sr)=render('/tmp/r2.wav')
print('reloaded freq', round(f0(d),3))
# also test: straight 8-bit path with sample_load (16-bit wav -> 8-bit flags)
PY"}

Let me check: in my earlier "loop reload" test I used flags=17 (16-bit) and got garbage. Let me test the SAME with flags=1 (8-bit): save → reload → check pitch/export.

If 8-bit round-trips correctly, then the safe choice is: **use 8-bit samples** → the XM files will be standard (length in samples == bytes ✓) and reloading works ✓ (assuming the round trip is right).

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from exp import *
import numpy as np
def run_case(label, cyc, reps, flags=1, note='C-4'):
    L=len(cyc)*reps
    x=np.tile(cyc,reps)
    pcm=(x*30000).astype('<i2').tobytes()
    b64=base64.b64encode(pcm).decode()
    run([{'name':'module_new','arguments':{'name':'T','channels':2}},
         {'name':'sample_create_from_pcm','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'pcm':b64,'encoding':'int16','name':'s'}},
         {'name':'sample_set','arguments':{'instrument':1,'sample':0,'volume':64,'loop_start':0,'loop_length':L,'flags':flags,'finetune':0,'relative_note':0}},
         {'name':'song_set','arguments':{'bpm':145,'speed':6}},
         {'name':'pattern_set_length','arguments':{'pattern':0,'rows':4}},
         {'name':'pattern_set_cell','arguments':{'pattern':0,'row':0,'channel':0,'note':note,'instrument':1,'volume':64}}])
    (d,sr)=render('/tmp/tb.wav')
    seg=d[500:2000,0]
    z=np.where(np.diff(np.sign(seg-0.0))>0)[0]
    print(label,'loop L=',L,' zc diffs:',np.diff(z)[:8],' rms',round(np.sqrt((d[:,0]**2).mean()),0),
          ' expected period(out samples)', round(44100/(8363*reps/len(cyc))))
# known good: single period of 256
cyc=np.sin(2*np.pi*np.arange(256)/256)
run_case('1x256 one period', cyc, 1)
# 128-sample loop, one period of 128
cyc2=np.sin(2*np.pi*np.arange(128)/128)
run_case('1x128 one period', cyc2, 1)
# 128-sample loop, 4 periods of 32
cyc3=np.sin(2*np.pi*np.arange(32)/32)
run_case('4x32 four periods', cyc3, 4)
run_case('2x64 two periods', np.sin(2*np.pi*np.arange(64)/64), 2)
PY"}

cd /workspace/src && python3 - <<'PY'
p='build.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""INSTS = [""","""import os
SOLO = int(os.environ.get('SOLO', 0))

INSTS = [""")
s=s.replace("""def main():
    s, nrows = build_grid()""","""def main():
    s, nrows = build_grid()
    if SOLO:
        INSTS[:] = [(i, fn, nm, (vol if i == SOLO else 0), pan, lp) for i, fn, nm, vol, pan, lp in INSTS]""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cat > /workspace/src/solotest.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: solotest.sh INST [startrow] [nrows-to-print]
set -e
export SOLO=$1
cd /workspace/src && python3 build.py > /dev/null
cd /workspace && ft2 batch /tmp/build.json > /dev/null
ft2 call module_render '{"path":"/tmp/solo.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":8,"loops":1}' > /dev/null
python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/src')
from analyze import load, peaks, nname
import numpy as np
d,sr=load('/tmp/solo.wav')
BPM=145; ROW=60.0/(BPM*4); BAR=ROW*16
inst=int(sys.argv[1])
start=4*BAR  # theme start
for b in range(4):
    t0=start+b*BAR
    out=[]
    for r in [0,2,4,6,8,10,12,14]:
        ps=peaks(d,t0+r*ROW+0.02,k=2,nwin=4096)
        strong=[f for f,a in ps if a>0.25]
        out.append(f'r{r}:' + ('/'.join(f'{int(round(f))}' for f in strong) if strong else '-'))
    print(f'inst{inst} bar{b}: '+'  '.join(out))
PY
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/src/solotest.sh && /workspace/src/solotest.sh 11 && /workspace/src/solotest.sh 10 && /workspace/src/solotest.sh 7

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/chk.py <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/src')
from analyze import load, nname
import numpy as np
d,sr=load('/tmp/solo.wav')
ROW=60.0/(145*4); BAR=ROW*16
def strong(t0, fmin=40, fmax=2000, dur=0.09, thresh=0.15):
    i0=int(t0*sr); n=int(dur*sr)
    seg=d[i0:i0+n].mean(axis=1); seg=seg-seg.mean()
    W=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))
    f=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    m=(f>fmin)&(f<fmax)
    W=W[m]; f=f[m]
    idx=np.argsort(W)[::-1][:4]
    return [(round(f[i],1), round(W[i]/W[idx[0]],2)) for i in idx]
inst=int(sys.argv[1])
start=4*BAR
for b in range(4):
    out=[]
    for r in range(0,16,2):
        ps=strong(start+b*BAR+r*ROW+0.02)
        out.append(f'r{r}:'+','.join(str(int(f)) for f,a in ps if a>0.2))
    print(f'inst{inst} bar{b}: '+' '.join(out))
EOF
export SOLO=7; python3 src/build.py>/dev/null; ft2 batch /tmp/build.json>/dev/null; ft2 call module_render '{"path":"/tmp/solo.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"amp":8,"loops":1}'>/dev/null; python3 /tmp/chk.py 7

{"command": "cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import wave, numpy as np
def load(p):
    w=wave.open(p); return np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,2).astype(float)
a=load('/tmp/amp8.wav').mean(axis=1); b=load('/tmp/reload8.wav').mean(axis=1)
seg=(100000,300000)
x=a[seg[0]:seg[1]]; y=b[seg[0]:seg[1]]
# best lag
best=None
for lag in range(-4,5):
    yy=b[seg[0]+lag:seg[1]+lag]
    c=np.corrcoef(x,yy)[0,1]
    if best is None or c>best[1]: best=(lag,c)

{"command": "cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, struct, os
res=[]
try:
    d=open('/workspace/submission/tune.xm','rb').read()
    res.append(f'size={len(d)} magic={d[:17]!r}')
    hdrsize,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,60)
    songlen,restart=struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,64)
    chans,npat,ninst=struct.unpack_from('<HHH',d,68)
    flags,tempo,bpm=struct.unpack_from('<HHH',d,74)
    order=list(d[80:80+songlen])
    res.append(f'hdrsize={hdrsize} songlen={songlen} chans={chans} npat={npat} ninst={ninst} bpm={bpm} tempo={tempo} order={order}')
    # patterns
    off=60+hdrsize
    pats=[]
    for i in range(npat):
        hs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off)
        ptype=d[off+4]; rows,packed=struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,off+5)
        data=d[off+hs:off+hs+packed]; off+=hs+packed
        cells=[]; j=0
        for r in range(rows):
            row=[]
            for c in range(chans):
                b=data[j]; j+=1
                if b & 0x80:
                    cell=[0,0,0,0,0]
                    if b & 1: cell[0]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 2: cell[1]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 4: cell[2]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 8: cell[3]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 16: cell[4]=data[j]; j+=1
                else:
                    cell=[b,data[j],data[j+1],data[j+2],data[j+3]]; j+=4
                row.append(tuple(cell))
            cells.append(row)
        pats.append((rows,j,packed,cells))
    # compare with expectation from the build calls
    calls=json.load(open('/workspace/submission/src/build_calls.json'))
    exp={}
    for call in calls:
        a=call['arguments']
        if call['name']=='pattern_set_cell':
            exp[(a['pattern'],a['row'],a['channel'])]=(a.get('note',0),a.get('instrument',0),a.get('volume',0),a.get('effect',0),a.get('effect_param',0))
    got={}
    ok=True; mism=0
    for pi,(rows,j,packed,cells) in enumerate(pats):
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(chans):
                t=tuple(cells[r][c])
                if any(t):
                    got[(pi,r,c)]=t
    res.append(f'parsed cells with data={len(got)} expected={len(exp)}')
    for k,v in exp.items():
        g=got.get(k)
        if g is None:
            mism+=1
        else:
            # instrument/note must match exactly; volume may be scaled by GAIN
            if (g[0],g[1],g[3],g[4])!=(v[0],v[1],v[3],v[4]):
                mism+=1
    extra=len([k for k in got if k not in exp])
    res.append(f'mismatched={mism} extra_cells={extra}')
    # instruments
    ins=[]
    for i in range(ninst):
        ihs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off)
        nm=d[off+4:off+26].rstrip(b'\0').decode()
        nsamp,=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,off+27)
        shs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off+29)
        hoff=off+ihs
        samples=[]
        p=hoff
        for k in range(nsamp):
            L,LS,LL=struct.unpack_from('<III',d,p)
            typ=d[p+14]; vol=d[p+12]; pan=d[p+15]
            samples.append((L,LS,LL,typ,vol,pan,round(LS+LL-L)))
            p+=shs
        off=p
        for (L,LS,LL,typ,vol,pan,diff) in samples:
            off+= (L if not (typ&16) else L*2)
        ins.append((nm,nsamp,samples))
    res.append('final_off_vs_size off=%d size=%d' % (off,len(d)))
    for nm,ns,samples in ins:

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, struct, os
res=[]
try:
    d=open('/workspace/submission/tune.xm','rb').read()
    res.append(f'size={len(d)} magic={d[:17]!r}')
    hdrsize,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,60)
    songlen,restart=struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,64)
    chans,npat,ninst=struct.unpack_from('<HHH',d,68)
    flags,tempo,bpm=struct.unpack_from('<HHH',d,74)
    order=list(d[80:80+songlen])
    res.append(f'hdrsize={hdrsize} songlen={songlen} chans={chans} npat={npat} ninst={ninst} bpm={bpm} tempo={tempo} order={order}')
    # patterns
    off=60+hdrsize
    pats=[]
    for i in range(npat):
        hs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off)
        ptype=d[off+4]; rows,packed=struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,off+5)
        data=d[off+hs:off+hs+packed]; off+=hs+packed
        cells=[]; j=0
        for r in range(rows):
            row=[]
            for c in range(chans):
                b=data[j]; j+=1
                if b & 0x80:
                    cell=[0,0,0,0,0]
                    if b & 1: cell[0]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 2: cell[1]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 4: cell[2]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 8: cell[3]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 16: cell[4]=data[j]; j+=1
                else:
                    cell=[b,data[j],data[j+1],data[j+2],data[j+3]]; j+=4
                row.append(tuple(cell))
            cells.append(row)
        pats.append((rows,j,packed,cells))
    # compare with expectation from the build calls
    calls=json.load(open('/workspace/submission/src/build_calls.json'))
    exp={}
    for call in calls:
        a=call['arguments']
        if call['name']=='pattern_set_cell':
            exp[(a['pattern'],a['row'],a['channel'])]=(a.get('note',0),a.get('instrument',0),a.get('volume',0),a.get('effect',0),a.get('effect_param',0))
    got={}
    ok=True; mism=0
    for pi,(rows,j,packed,cells) in enumerate(pats):
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(chans):
                t=tuple(cells[r][c])
                if any(t):
                    got[(pi,r,c)]=t
    res.append(f'parsed cells with data={len(got)} expected={len(exp)}')
    for k,v in exp.items():
        g=got.get(k)
        if g is None:
            mism+=1
        else:
            # instrument/note must match exactly; volume may be scaled by GAIN
            if (g[0],g[1],g[3],g[4])!=(v[0],v[1],v[3],v[4]):
                mism+=1
    extra=len([k for k in got if k not in exp])
    res.append(f'mismatched={mism} extra_cells={extra}')
    # instruments
    ins=[]
    for i in range(ninst):
        ihs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off)
        nm=d[off+4:off+26].rstrip(b'\0').decode()
        nsamp,=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,off+27)
        shs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off+29)
        hoff=off+ihs
        samples=[]
        p=hoff
        for k in range(nsamp):
            L,LS,LL=struct.unpack_from('<III',d,p)
            typ=d[p+14]; vol=d[p+12]; pan=d[p+15]
            samples.append((L,LS,LL,typ,vol,pan,round(LS+LL-L)))
            p+=shs
        off=p
        for (L,LS,LL,typ,vol,pan,diff) in samples:
            off+= (L if not (typ&16) else L*2)
        ins.append((nm,nsamp,samples))
    res.append('final_off_vs_size off=%d size=%d' % (off,len(d)))
    for nm,ns,samples in ins:
        res.append(f'{nm:11s} nsamp={ns} '+ ';'.join(f'len={L} loop={LS},{LL} type={t} vol={v} pan={p}' for (L,LS,LL,t,v,p,_) in samples))
    good = (mism==0 and extra==0 and off==len(d))
    res.append('RESULT '+('OK' if good else 'PROBLEM'))
except Exception as e:
    import traceback
    res.append('EXC '+traceback.format_exc()[-300:])
    good=False
open('/workspace/src/verify_report.txt','w').write('\n'.join(res)+'\n')
os._exit(0 if good else 7)

import json, struct, os, traceback, shutil
res=[]; good=False
try:
    src=open('/tmp/tune_backup.xm','rb').read()
    d=bytearray(src)
    hdrsize,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,60)
    songlen,=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,64)
    chans,npat,ninst=struct.unpack_from('<HHH',d,68)
    off=60+hdrsize
    patched=[]; vols=[]
    for pi in range(npat):
        hs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off)
        rows,packed=struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,off+5)
        start=off+hs
        j=start
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(chans):
                b=d[j]; j+=1
                if b & 0x80:
                    if b & 1: j+=1
                    if b & 2: j+=1
                    if b & 4:
                        v=d[j]
                        vols.append((j,v)); j+=1
                    if b & 8: j+=1
                    if b & 16: j+=1
                else:
                    v=d[j+2]
                    vols.append((j+2,v))
                    j+=4
        off=start+packed
    res.append('cells_with_volume=%d' % len(vols))
    res.append('vol range before %d..%d' % (min(v for _,v in vols), max(v for _,v in vols)))
    cnt=0
    for pos,v in vols:
        if 0 < v <= 64:
            nv=max(2, int(round(v*0.85)))
            if nv!=v:
                d[pos]=nv; cnt+=1
                patched.append((pos,v,nv))
    res.append('patched %d volume bytes' % cnt)
    new=bytes(d)
    res.append('size same=%s' % (len(new)==len(src)))
    diffs=[i for i in range(len(src)) if src[i]!=new[i]]
    res.append('diff bytes=%d all_at_volume_positions=%s' % (len(diffs), all(i in {p[0] for p in patched} for i in diffs)))
    # verify reparsed content equals expectation
    calls=json.load(open('/workspace/submission/src/build_calls.json'))
    exp={}
    for call in calls:
        a=call['arguments']
        if call['name']=='pattern_set_cell':
            exp[(a['pattern'],a['row'],a['channel'])]=(a.get('note',0),a.get('instrument',0),a.get('volume',0),a.get('effect',0),a.get('effect_param',0))
    off=60+hdrsize
    got={}
    for pi in range(npat):
        hs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',new,off)
        rows,packed=struct.unpack_from('<HH',new,off+5)
        data=new[off+hs:off+hs+packed]; off+=hs+packed
        j=0
        for r in range(rows):
            for c in range(chans):
                b=data[j]; j+=1
                if b & 0x80:
                    cell=[0,0,0,0,0]
                    if b & 1: cell[0]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 2: cell[1]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 4: cell[2]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 8: cell[3]=data[j]; j+=1
                    if b & 16: cell[4]=data[j]; j+=1
                else:
                    cell=[b,data[j],data[j+1],data[j+2],data[j+3]]; j+=4
                got[(pi,r,c)]=tuple(cell)
    bad=0
    for k,v in exp.items():
        g=got.get(k)
        if g is None: bad+=1; continue
        if (g[0],g[1],g[3],g[4])!=(v[0],v[1],v[3],v[4]): bad+=1
        expv = max(2,int(round(v[2]*0.85))) if (0 < v[2] <= 64) else v[2]
        if g[2]!=expv: bad+=1
    res.append('reparse mismatches=%d' % bad)
    good = (len(diffs)==cnt and bad==0 and len(new)==len(src))
    if good:
        open('/tmp/tune_new.xm','wb').write(new)
        res.append('wrote /tmp/tune_new.xm')
    res.append('RESULT '+('OK' if good else 'PROBLEM'))
except Exception:
    res.append('EXC '+traceback.format_exc()[-400:])
open('/tmp/patch_report.txt','w').write('\n'.join(res)+'\n')
os._exit(0 if good else 7)

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/patch2.py <<'PY'
import json, struct, os, traceback
try:
    src=open('/tmp/tune_backup.xm','rb').read()
    d=bytearray(src)
    hdrsize,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,60)
    chans,npat=struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,68)
    off=60+hdrsize
    vols=[]
    for pi in range(npat):
        hs,=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off)
        rows,packed=struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,off+5)
        start=off+hs
        end=start+packed
        j=start
        while j<end:
            b=d[j]; j+=1
            if b & 0x80:
                if b & 1: j+=1
                if b & 2: j+=1
                if b & 4:
                    vols.append(j); j+=1
                if b & 8: j+=1
                if b & 16: j+=1
            else:
                vols.append(j+2); j+=4
        off=end
    patched={}
    for pos in vols:
        v=d[pos]
        if 0 < v <= 64:
            nv=max(2, int(round(v*0.85)))
            if nv!=v:
                d[pos]=nv
                patched[pos]=(v,nv)
    new=bytes(d)
    diffs=[i for i in range(len(src)) if src[i]!=new[i]]
    ok = (len(new)==len(src)) and all((i in patched) for i in diffs) and len(diffs)==len(patched)
    if ok:
        open('/tmp/tune_new.xm','wb').write(new)
    open('/tmp/patch2_report.txt','w').write('vols=%d patched=%d diffs=%d ok=%s\n' % (len(vols),len(patched),len(diffs),ok))
    os._exit(0 if ok else 7)
except Exception:
    open('/tmp/patch2_report.txt','w').write('EXC '+traceback.format_exc()[-300:]+'\n')
    os._exit(9)
PY

{"command": "cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
readme = '''Keygen Drive - FT2 (XM) module
===============================

tune.xm        : the editable FastTracker II module (12 instruments, 16 channels,
                 11 patterns x 64 rows, 145 BPM, speed 6 -> rows are 1/16 notes,
                 44 bars, ~1:12.8 loop)
preview.wav    : render of the module (ft2-clone, 44.1 kHz stereo)

Build
-----
src/waves.py    : playback-rate helpers and band-limited single-cycle synthesis
src/gen.py      : synthesises every instrument sample (src/wav/*.wav)
src/compose.py  : musical data + part writers (drums, bass, chords, arp, melody)
src/build.py    : arrangement -> FT2 tool calls -> tune.xm
src/build_calls.json : the exact tool calls used to build the module
src/analyze.py, src/chroma.py, src/xmcheck.py : offline checks used while writing
src/solotest.sh : renders one instrument alone

How it is put together
----------------------
All tonal instruments are one sample each: a single-cycle wavetable of 32 stored
samples, looped.  In XM a note consumes samples at 8363*2^((note-49)/12) Hz, so a
32-sample cycle sounds at concert pitch for the written note name (A-4 = 439.5 Hz),
which makes every instrument mutually in tune.  Each wavetable is additively
resynthesised with only the harmonics that stay below Nyquist at the top note of
its register, so nothing aliases.

Drums are one-shot samples authored at the rate they are played back at C-4, so
they are triggered with the note C-4 and keep the timbre they were designed with.

No envelopes are used (the tool set exposes none), so every shape is made by the
patterns themselves: volume-column shaping, note cuts (EC0) for the staccato
parts, and the last row of the song cuts every sustaining voice so the loop
restarts clean.

Structure (1 bar = 16 rows)
---------------------------
intro 4 bars | theme A 8 bars (Am F C G / Am F Dm E) | part B 8 bars
(F G Am Am / F G Dm E) | breakdown 4 bars | theme A' 8 bars | part B' 8 bars |
coda 4 bars with a hat roll into the loop point.
'''

import os
tot=0; cnt=0
for root,dirs,files in os.walk('/workspace/submission'):
    for f in files:

ok = tot < 128*1024*1024 and cnt < 4096

import os as o
o._exit(0 if ok else 7)""}
